title: Capstone 1: Monthly Revenue
story: The shop owner wants a monthly revenue report from delivered orders.
goal: Show month (YYYY-MM from order_date) and revenue (sum of qty*price for delivered orders), ordered by month.

tests.label: Hidden check on other data

hints: substr(order_date, 1, 7) gives YYYY-MM. Join products for the price.
GROUP BY month, with WHERE status = 'delivered'.
SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
explain: In one sentence: what does this query do, and why does it need the GROUP BY?
solution: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
alt: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
